title: Proposal: Allow authors to programmatically "save as PDF"

labels.name: needs implementer interest
labels.description: Moving the issue forward requires implementers to express interest

body:
There are several use cases where it would be handy to be able to show a "save as PDF" dialog programmatically. For example, a document editing application might want to allow their users to export the document as a PDF without using any PDF generation library. While most user agents already allow users to select a "save as PDF" option when a [document is printed](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/timers-and-user-prompts.html#printing) (e.g. when [`Window.print()`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/timers-and-user-prompts.html#dom-print) is called), there is currently no possibility for the author to hint the browser that the print dialog should be shown with the "save as PDF" option enabled.

I am proposing an addition to the [`Window.print()`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/timers-and-user-prompts.html#dom-print) method with an optional parameter that allows authors to tell the user agent the way that the print dialog should be shown:
```javascript
// The destination of the user agent's print dialog becomes "save as PDF", even if it would have been "print" otherwise.
window.print({ saveAsPDF: true });
```
If the user agent is not able to provide a way to export the document as a PDF, it may ignore this option.
